rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a trained person who rescues swimmers at a pool, beach, or other body of water.

example.english: The lifeguard immediately jumped into the water to save someone.
example.traditional: 個救生員即刻跳落水救人。
example.jyutping: go3 gau3 sang1 jyun4 zik1 hak1 tiu3 lok6 seoi2 gau3 jan4
